newsitem.title: USA: American Bio completes $1.5 mln financing.
newsitem.headline: American Bio completes $1.5 mln financing.

text.p: American Bio Medica Corp said on Wednesday it had completed an equity financing of $1.5 million.
It said it would use the proceeds from the financing, which was provided by Midland Walwyn Inc, to increase its manufacturing capabilities.

American Bio Medica President Stan Cipkowski said in a statement, "The demand for the Rapid Drug Screen Kit has surpassed our expectations. This latest financing is instrumental in assuring that (merican Bio Medica) will meet the growing demand for this product."
